name: Lovecubus! ~Onna no Ko Akuma ♀♂ Otoko no Ko Akuma~
original_name: らぶきゅばす！ ～おんなのこあくま♀♂おとこのこあくま～
source:
The Protagonist Tarou has a correspondent who is an English girl. One day, his correspondent Elena's family moves to Japan and they meet for the first time. With an awful start to their meeting, a dislike for each other emerges. Tarou is handed a handwritten book from Elena, and as he flips through the pages he recalls memories of his previous life.

In reality, Tarou is a wizard who has repeatedly reincarnated for the purpose of studying sexual magic. With the memories of his previous life back, he casts a spell to summon the lecherous demon siblings, Leene and Ruuna who live in the demon world.

In Tarou's previous life he had also summoned the demon siblings and subjected them to the tantric mysteries of India and Taoist sexual practices. Then one day, Elena witnesses the three of them having sex and at that moment she regains memories of her past life.

Also a sorceress she was defeated and humiliated by Tarou in her most recent previous life. With revenge in her heart, Elena plans to use her sexual magic to trick Tarou.

On the other hand, the lecherous siblings are looking for an opportunity to escape Tarou.

A feast of sexual magic and with the danger of catastrophe, things are about to get more and more perverse.

[Translated from [url=https://digitalcute.com/cuterush/]the game's Official Homepage[/url].]
translation:
主人公太郎有一位英国笔友。某天，笔友艾莲娜一家搬到日本，两人终于初次见面。糟糕的开场让他们彼此心生厌恶。艾莲娜交给太郎一本手写的书，他翻阅书页时，想起了前世的记忆。

事实上，太郎是一名为了研究性爱魔法而不断转世的魔法师。恢复前世记忆后，他施法召唤出居住在魔界的淫魔姐弟莉妮与露娜。

太郎前世也曾召唤这对姐弟，让他们体验印度密宗奥义与道教房中术。某天，艾莲娜目睹三人交媾，也在那一刻恢复了前世记忆。

她同样是魔女，曾在最近一次前世中被太郎打败并羞辱。心怀复仇的艾莲娜计划用性爱魔法欺骗太郎。

另一方面，淫魔姐弟则伺机逃离太郎。

性爱魔法的盛宴与毁灭危机交织，事态即将变得愈发淫乱。
